system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: PowerShell ran on WS-MLOPEZ-01 at 13:41:49 as HARBOR-DENTAL\omar.haddad, with the command to run \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1. The Sysmon and Windows process-creation records agree on the command and logon ID.
The same logon ID had a network logon for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01 shortly before PowerShell started, consistent with the stated remote-administration practice.

PowerShell launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 KB package; the proxy recorded a Windows Update Agent connection transferring about 38.8 MB, and PowerShell subsequently exited. This sequence is consistent with the stated workstation-patching activity.

The provided records show conhost.exe instances around the reported period, but those records identify csrss.exe—not the recorded PowerShell process—as their parent. They do not establish that those particular conhost instances displayed the PowerShell window Maria reported.

The proxy recorded connections to Google Drive and Dropbox-related endpoints during the review window. The supplied inventory does not approve those services, so these are separate policy-review items; the cited records alone do not show that files were uploaded.
A brief SMB connection from WS-MLOPEZ-01 to FILE-HD-01 was accompanied by an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. The records do not establish what share or resource was accessed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records do not include PowerShell script-block, transcript, or script-file content, so they show the command line but not what the patch script did internally.
The available process records do not link the reported visible window to a specific conhost.exe instance.
The proxy records identify the Google Drive and Dropbox-related connections and byte counts, but do not establish file contents or whether a file transfer occurred.
The SMB records show a connection and anonymous network logon, but not the share-level or file-level operations.
claims_not_established: The records do not independently establish who authorized or initiated the remote patch run, though its account, source host, command, and timing are consistent with the supplied IT practice and patching schedule.
The records do not establish the contents, integrity, or provenance of Deploy-Patches.ps1 or the KB package.
The records do not establish that the Google Drive or Dropbox-related connections transferred organizational data.
The records do not establish what resource, if any, was accessed during the anonymous SMB session.
additional_evidence_needed: For separate follow-up on the unapproved cloud-service connections, review endpoint software inventory and relevant proxy or application-transfer records.
If the SMB event requires investigation, obtain FILE-HD-01 share and file-access auditing for the session around 13:43:16 UTC.
